data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 演出间隙
data.description: 演出间隙，她对着镜子把披风搭好。有人又提起角色的夸张称号，她抬眼瞪了一下，自己也忍不住笑了。
data.promptProse: Inside a cramped, dimly lit backstage dressing room filled with the scent of hairspray, Fiammetta stands before a vanity mirror surrounded by bright, hot marquee bulbs, meticulously arranging the folds of her vibrant red performance cape. Costume racks laden with elaborate theater attire, props, and scattered script pages create a chaotic, lively backstage atmosphere, while her expression transitions from tense to amused as she reflects in the glass.
